versions.changelog:
liebin 0.1.0

- Initial release of the “liebin” skill for design direction confirmation before hands-on page building.
- Provides a four-step process: (1) collecting real content and references, (2) creating three axis-based design variants, (3) confirming direction with a structured feedback step, and (4) documenting choices in a standardized DESIGN.md.
- Emphasizes rendering three parallel design samples using actual product copy—never placeholders—to drive concrete decision-making.
- Includes tools and templates for sample generation, confirmation forms, and post-launch verification against original intent.
- Outlines clear boundaries on “what can and cannot be borrowed” in design, and highlights common pitfalls to avoid throughout the process.
